name: falsewake

scripts.test:cases: node scripts/cases-native-test.mjs && npm run build && node --test tests/cases.test.mjs
scripts.test:nightfall: node scripts/nightfall-native-test.mjs && node scripts/hollow-native-test.mjs && npm run build && node --test tests/nightfall.test.mjs tests/hollow.test.mjs
